interface.longDescription: Three optional reusable methods around native ChatGPT: bounded decision analysis, intended-use work-product evaluation, and scoped Human-AI system development. This plugin is not a runtime, router, lifecycle, or complete provider universe.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this bounded material decision when a reusable decision method adds value.
Evaluate whether this exact work product is fit for its intended recipient and use.
Recover or diagnose this Human-AI work system when system-development work is actually required.
